title: CRT degree and matrix coordinate sublemmas
statement: For a monic polynomial factorization modulo an ideal, (1) the degree index sets admit an equivalence, and (2) for any such equivalence there is a CRT conjugating unit giving the block matrix identity.

proof.text: Degree additivity follows from monicity and the factorization.
CRT and power-basis coordinate calculations produce the conjugating unit and matrix identity.

lean.statement: theorem adjoinRoot_crt_degree_equiv {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [Nontrivial (A ⧸ I)] (f : A[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (g h : (A ⧸ I)[X]) (hg : g.Monic) (hh : h.Monic) (hfactor : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = g * h) : Nonempty (Fin f.natDegree ≃ (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree))
